STEP 1 - Vessel type: The food sits in a white oval bowl with a clearly curved inner wall, and the greens rise up toward the rim, so it is a shallow-to-medium serving bowl.

STEP 2 - Vessel size:
a) Type cue: a salad or serving bowl is typically 20-25 cm. This one looks like a medium salad bowl, around 22 cm.
b) Reference cue: cucumber slices are about 2-3 cm thick and the kidney beans are about 2 cm long. The bowl spans roughly 10-11 bean lengths across, so width ≈ 22 cm.
Reconciled width: 22 cm.

STEP 3 - Items:
- Bowl capacity: shallow-ish bowl, 0.2 x 22^3 / 1000 = 2.13 L. Fill looks about 0.6 of depth (greens heaped a bit above the mid-wall), so food volume ≈ 2130 x 0.6 x 0.6 ≈ 770 ml, split by share.
- Raw spinach/leafy greens (~55% of volume, ~420 ml) x 0.15 = 63 g.
- Kidney beans (marinated, dark red), countable: about 30 visible, plus hidden ones, ~35 total x 1.5 g per bean (similar to a bean, roughly 1.5-2 g each in this context; I use 2 g) ≈ 70 g. Treating them as ~20% of volume ≈ 150 ml x 0.9 ≈ 140 g, I take ~110 g as the middle estimate.
- Cucumber, chopped (~20% of volume, ~150 ml) x 0.6 = 90 g.
- Black olives: about 3 visible, ~4 g each ≈ 12 g.
- Dressing: no visible pooling, so negligible; add ~5 g.

Total ≈ 63 + 110 + 90 + 12 + 5 ≈ 280 g.

STEP 4 - Hidden food: The greens form the base layer, already counted. No extra hidden base.

STEP 5 - kcal per 100 g:
- Raw spinach: 23 kcal
- Kidney beans, canned/marinated: ~120 kcal
- Cucumber: 15 kcal
- Black olives: 115 kcal
- Dressing/oil: ~80 kcal (5 g is negligible)

Estimated total: about 280 g, roughly 2 x 10^2 kcal (approx. 0.63 kcal/g average -> ~175-190 kcal).
